Raw source root:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kodrin/URP-PSX/83670002c8893b0e9156c6145684697f38b712ec/

Adaptation in Assets/RetroToon/Shaders/RetroPrint.shader:
  - Pixelation and color-precision floor operations adapted from Pixelation.shader.
  - Screen-coordinate 4x4 matrix indexing adapted from Dithering.shader.
  - Replaced binary brightness cutout with centered Bayer color quantization.
  - Replaced UnityCG / mesh blit with URP 17 Core Blit and XR texture macros.
  - Added depth/normal ink edges, orthographic depth support, static grain,
    perceptual color grading, color-registration offset, and effect blending.

The upstream project targets Unity 2019.3 / URP 7.1.8. Its old renderer-feature
scripts are intentionally not imported. The adapted shader uses the existing
Unity 6 Full Screen Pass Renderer Feature.
